name: hud_ui_options_panel_full_hud_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_FullHud::InitFromOptions reads the current hardware-mode HUD type option and checks the full-HUD toggle when the type is perspective.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. Current Binary Ninja HLIL still renders the bool temporary as a byte assignment, but the source behavior is verified against current decompilation.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40ca80 compares zOpt::GetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode against ZOPT_HUD_TYPE_PERSPECTIVE, passes that boolean to HudUiCheckToggleWidget::SetChecked, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_full_hud_init_from_options_smoke installs software and hardware HUD type option pointers, exercises both hardware-mode selectors, and verifies the checked state is set only for ZOPT_HUD_TYPE_PERSPECTIVE.
